ruff:E501.note: Line too long — autofix via ruff format

ruff:UP*.note: pyupgrade — safe fixes apply automatically; unsafe fixes (--unsafe-fixes) and residual structural rewrites fall through to build-simplify

ruff:fastapi-*.note: FastAPI rules FAST001/002/003 all support automatic fixes

pyright:reportArgumentType.note: Argument type mismatch — often a polymorphic fn needing TypeVar (Branch 3)

pyright:reportReturnType.note: Return type mismatch — Branch 2 (Annotate) or Branch 1 (Narrow)

pyright:reportOperatorIssue.note: Operator not defined for type — Branch 1 (Narrow) or Branch 4 (Protocol)

pyright:reportIndexIssue.note: Subscript/index type error — Branch 1 (Narrow) or Branch 3 (TypeVar)

pyright:reportGeneralTypeIssues.note: Generic type errors — route to build-fix-types (6-branch decision tree)

pyright:reportUnknownMemberType.note: Missing/wrong stubs — Branch 6 (type: ignore with reason)

mypy:*.note: All mypy findings — route to build-fix-types; per-code dispatch in SKILL.md classification table

pyright:langgraph-reducer-mismatch.note: LangGraph reducer/state shape mismatch — needs reflexion

pyright:asyncpg-*.note: asyncpg type issues — route to langgraph-fundamentals

biome:lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDepe.note: React hook dependency — route to frontend-design

react:render-or-hook-generic.note: Generic React render or hook failure

markdownlint:MD0*.note: markdownlint --fix handles most MD0xx rules; structural rules (MD001/024/025/033/043/052/…) fall through to makato-core:markdown — the domain skill for markdown structure, not build-simplify

sqlfluff:*.note: sqlfluff fix handles formatting/layout rules; residual structural violations fall through to manage-postgres for Postgres-standards review

bandit:B105.note: Hardcoded password string — FP detection and suppress/carry-over handled in build-fix-security (CWE-798)

bandit:B107.note: Hardcoded password default arg — FP detection handled in build-fix-security (CWE-798)

bandit:*.note: Catch-all bandit findings — per-CWE 4-branch playbook in build-fix-security

safety:*.note: Vulnerable dependency (safety) — upgrade-or-ignore flow in build-fix-security

pip-audit:*.note: Vulnerable dependency (pip-audit) — upgrade-or-ignore flow in build-fix-security

gitleaks:*.note: Secret leak — redact in working tree and file an issue for rotation

trivy:CRITICAL.note: Critical CVE — attempt dependency upgrade, otherwise document ignore reason

trivy:HIGH.note: High CVE — attempt dependency upgrade, otherwise document ignore reason

trivy:MEDIUM.note: Medium CVE — match CRITICAL/HIGH route: attempt dependency upgrade, otherwise document ignore reason

semgrep:*.note: Rules with `fix:`/`fix-regex:` apply automatically; rules without fall through to build-simplify

promptfoo:assertion-failed.note: Prompt eval assertion failure — adversarial reflexion
